meta.name: api-rate-limiting
meta.description: Implement API rate limiting strategies using token bucket, sliding window, and fixed window algorithms. Use when protecting APIs from abuse, managing traffic, or implementing tiered rate limits.

copy.tagline: 用令牌桶、滑动窗口等算法保护 API 免遭滥用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为 API 实现限流策略来防止滥用或管理流量。
copy.tagline_en: Protect APIs from abuse with token bucket, sliding window, and fixed window algorithms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to implement rate limiting strategies to protect APIs from abuse or manage traffic.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你实现 API 限流策略，包括令牌桶、滑动窗口和固定窗口算法，保护 API 免遭滥用和管理流量。
howto.when: 当你提出需要保护 API、防止滥用、管理流量或实现分级限流时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 JavaScript 实现一个令牌桶限流器。
say.note: Claude 会给出代码和用法。

say.text: 如何在 Redis 中实现分布式限流？
say.note: Claude 会解释方案并提供示例。

say.text: 为不同用户层级设计限流策略。
say.note: Claude 会给出分级限流建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you implement API rate limiting strategies using token bucket, sliding window, and fixed window algorithms to protect APIs from abuse and manage traffic.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to protect APIs, prevent abuse, manage traffic, or implement tiered rate limits.

say_en.text: Implement a token bucket rate limiter in JavaScript.
say_en.note: Claude will provide code and usage.

say_en.text: How to implement distributed rate limiting with Redis?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the approach and give examples.

say_en.text: Design rate limiting strategies for different user tiers.
say_en.note: Claude will provide tiered limit suggestions.
